# Cantieri AI

> Cantieri AI (cantieri.ai) is a cloud-based digital platform for construction site management. It helps construction companies, site directors, surveyors and engineers manage daily reports, documents, safety compliance and work progress from a single app.

## Key Features

- Digital daily reports (rapportini digitali) replacing paper-based workflows
- Construction site safety management with checklists, PPE tracking and incident reporting
- Multi-company collaboration on the same construction site
- Real-time dashboards for costs, materials, hours worked and work progress
- SAL (Stato Avanzamento Lavori) digital tracking
- Document management and cloud storage
- Task assignment with instant notifications
- Automatic daily and weekly PDF reports
- Offline mode with automatic sync

## Target Users

- Construction companies (imprese edili)
- Site directors (direttori lavori)
- Surveyors (geometri)
- Engineers (ingegneri)
- Foremen (caposquadra)

## Pricing

Free trial available. Flexible plans based on number of sites and users. Contact info@cantieri.ai for a personalized quote.
